sentences.text: Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
3. Petitioner seeks anticipatory bail in case FIR No.210/2022 under Section 420/120B IPC and Section 66C/66D of the Information and Technology Act registered at police station Crime Branch.
4. The matter pertains to cheating of Rs.1.22 Crores from complainant by four accused person.
It is submitted Rs.22.50 lacs was allegedly transferred in the account of petitioner.

The matter is stated to have been settled by the petitioner with complainant for Rs.22.00 lacs, out of which Rs.11.00 lacs stood already paid and today a draft for balance of Rs.11.00 lacs has been handed over to complainant, present in Court.
The copy of draft is annexed as annexure P5, placed at page No.123 of the paperbook.
5. It is alleged the petitioner has not joined the investigation.
The petitioner is directed to join the investigation with the Investigating Officer as and when directed to do so till the next date of hearing.
Status report be filed by the police in this regard on next date of hearing.

6. List again on 03.08.2023 and in the meanwhile, subject to petitioner's joining the investigation,
the petitioner be not arrested in this case.
